extracted.intended_audience: members of the media / press seeking information from the American Red Cross
extracted.subtask_description: Provides contact instructions and topical areas for press/media inquiries to the American Red Cross, distinguishing national/international vs. local media and directing non-press users to general contact channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: National or International Press Inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are a member of the national or international media and have question about the national Red Cross, please call 202-303-5551 or email: media@redcross.org
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided national phone number (202-303-5551) or the media@redcross.org email address for inquiries about the national Red Cross or issues that are national/international in scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local Press Inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are a member of the local media, your local American Red Cross chapter is often the best source of information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact your local Red Cross chapter for local stories and information; use the 'Find your local Red Cross' link to locate local chapter contact details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical Areas Covered by Media Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: The American Red Cross has personnel available on a variety of different topics, including Blood and Biomedical Services; Domestic Disaster Response and Relief; Service to the Armed Forces; American Red Cross activities in other countries; Training Services; General Red Cross Questions or Issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing a media inquiry, identify which topical area your question relates to (from the listed categories) so you can be directed to the appropriate personnel or department.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance for Non-Press Individuals
rubrics_metrics.description: Not a Member of the Press: If you have general questions about the Red Cross, please see Contact Us.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individuals who are not members of the press should not use the media contact channels; instead, use the general 'Contact Us' resources for public inquiries or support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of Local Media Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Many of the Red Cross chapters, Blood Services regions and stations have personnel immediately available to meet your media needs on a variety of different topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For timely or local-stage media needs, prefer contacting regional/chapter-level personnel who may be immediately available to assist.
